source_text: 92. Et le Verbe lui-même, en Isaïe, déclare qu'il s'est rendu visible parmi nous, et que le Fils de Dieu, devenu fils de l'homme, il se trouve au milieu de nous, qui auparavant étions dans l'ignorance: «J'ai apparu à ceux qui ne me cherchaient pas, dit-il, j'ai été trouvé par ceux qui ne me demandaient pas. J'ai dit: Me voici! à une nation qui n'invoquait pas mon nom» (Is 65, 1).
pass_a_gloss: §92 dual gloss (Armenian-via-French sense) ≠ Pass B running English. Theme: Gentiles become God’s people with new hearts.
pass_b_english: And this nation is to be called a holy people, as Hosea, one of the Twelve, announces: ‘I have called my people him who was not my people, and Beloved her who was not beloved. And in the very place where it was said: You are not my people, they shall be called sons of the living God.’ ([[Hos 2:23 >> Bible:Hos 2:23]]; [[Rom 9:25-26 >> Bible:Rom 9:25-26]])

Did not John the Baptist himself say: ‘God is able from these stones to raise up children for Abraham’? ([[Mt 3:9 >> Bible:Mt 3:9]]) For our hearts have been torn from idol worship by faith in God; we become sons of Abraham, who was justified by faith. ([[Gal 3:7-9 >> Bible:Gal 3:7-9]])

So God says through Ezekiel: ‘I will give them another heart; I will put a new spirit within them. I will remove the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh, that they may walk in my statutes… And they shall be my people and I will be their God.’ ([[Ezek 11:19-20 >> Bible:Ezek 11:19-20]]; [[Ezek 36:26-28 >> Bible:Ezek 36:26-28]])
